title: Crossfire · Native Development
summary: Native source-derived corridors, actors, independent shooting, ammunition, bonuses, waves and score rules with original monochrome sprite masks. Original clock, colors, sound and loader transition remain unqualified.
notes: Native ARM64 development reconstruction; no source CPU executes. This is not a completed faithful rewrite.
Prepared original media are required. Run Tools/decode_crossfire.py after Tools/prepare_retro_media.py, then refresh the library. Original media stay local and are excluded from Git.
Native source/version-validated save/resume, pause and launch/return adapters. Behavior, visuals, audio, original modes and physical controller acceptance remain incomplete.
M5 Pro / 24 GB is development evidence only. Mandatory M1 Air / 8 GB sustained acceptance remains unverified.
keyboard: I / J / K / L or arrows: move
E / S / D / F: fire up / left / down / right
Space: stop; Escape: pause; Ctrl-S: source audio toggle (audio output pending)
controller: Left stick / D-pad: move; right stick: fire
X left / Y up / A down / RB right: fire
